I've realized that /v/askvoat can become another /r/AskReddit. I have created /v/seriousdiscussion a while ago to become the serious place of voat to discuss your favorite topics. I post there occasionally to keep it active and fresh so I can grow it to eventually become one of the defining subverses of voat. The difference between /v/askvoat and /v/seriousdiscussion is merely the fact that low-effort comments are removed. So I don't sound too broad, examples of comments that will be removed:

  • I agree.
  • This.
  • This was a great read.
  • I finally found my hero.

Basically, low-effort comments and jokes standing on their own will be removed, but clarifying questions, well-versed counter-arguments, jokes that are also accommodated with a serious point or opinion, will not.

The purpose of the sub is to form the community here into one who values serious replies and not puns or dumb copy-paste comments. The more popular it gets, the more likely its goal will be achieved. If anyone is interested in this agenda, please head over and join the discussion. :-)

All in all, I cannot say whether or not /v/askvoat will become another /r/AskReddit, but I can only try to make serious topics something that the community values more. I'm sorry if this comment couldn't satisfy as an answer to your question.

Edit: accomodated to accommodated.

It'll be high quality, low volume for a while until traffic reaches a critical mass. Once the floodgates open it'll take a lot of moderator work to keep it clean. Don't worry though - we're a long way from that.

Voat is still young and we don't know exactly what it will become yet, so let's do our best to set a good example of quality and openness. We can't keep the toxicity out forever, but we can use our limited time for the betterment of this community.
